Aged About 20 Years, Occupation: Labour, R/O
Village Kalapipal Tahsil- Chachoda, District-
Guna (Madhya Pradesh)
 .....Applicant
(By Shri Rajnish Sharma - Advocate)
And

1. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION- RADHOGARH, DISTRICT- GUNA  (MADHYA PRADESH)
2. PROSECUTRIX THROUGH POLICE STATION-  RADHORAGH, DISTRICT- GUNA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENTS (SHRI B.M. SHRIVASTAVA- PUBLIC PROSECUTOR FOR THE STATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Case Diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
This is the Fifth bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 31/01/2022 passed in MCRC No.5002/2022, Second application was dismissed vide order dated 20/04/2022 passed in MCRC No.17616/2022, Third application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 05/07/2022 passed in MCRC No.32332/2022 and Fourth application was dismissed in Mahendra Banjara vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86751794/

sentences.text: 1 absence of change of circumstances vide order dated 14/11/2022 passed in MCRC No.50514/2022 respectively by the Coordinate Bench (Hon'ble Shri Justice G.S. Ahluwalia) who has been transferred to Main Seat, Jabalpur (M.P.).

The applicant was arrested on 30/12/2021 by Police Station- Raghogarh, District- Guna (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.261/2020 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of IPC and Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act.

Prosecution story, in short, is that the complainant lodged the report that o n 14/05/2020 in the night, he alongwith his wife and daughter aged about 17 years slept outside the house and when he awoke in the morning, her daughter was not there.
He searched her here and there but could not trace her.
He expressed the doubt that somebody has taken by persuading her.
Thereafter, on his information, FIR was registered.

Thereafter, prosecutrix was recovered on 28/12/2021 and her statement was recorded in which she stated that prosecutrix and the applicant knew each other and they solemnized the marriage at Kalapeepal and out of their wedlock, she born the girl child.
She was living with the applicant as wife.
On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the applicant.
She was sent for medical examination.
Thereafter, applicant was arrested on 30/12/2021 and after investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is aged 20 years and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
After investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.
The applicant is in custody since 30/12/2021 and he is the permanent resident of District- Guna (M.P.).
There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for dismissal of the application.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if applicant furnishes a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
